seo.title: About HeartLink - Gopi Shah & Alpa Apoorva
seo.description: Meet HeartLink co-founders Gopi Shah and Alpa Apoorva, who bring equal parts family judgment, matchmaking experience and relationship guidance.

hero.title: A trusted team for serious families.
hero.description: HeartLink is co-founded and personally led by Gopi Shah and Alpa Apoorva. Their complementary experience shapes every serious introduction.

curators.name: Gopi Shah
curators.title: Trusted networks, community experience and family judgment.
curators.lead: Gopi Shah brings hands-on matrimonial service and decades of community leadership to HeartLink.
paragraphs: Gopi's career spans education, culture and community service. Her work has included Khar Education Society, cultural collaborations in India and the United States, and community initiatives with NGO Jwala.
She founded Jeevansaathi, an honorary matrimonial service in Juhu, and brings that practical experience to every family conversation at HeartLink.
Gopi is Maharashtra State Chair for G100's Luxury, Fashion, Beauty, Jewellery & Textiles wing and a recipient of the Dr. Sarojini Naidu International Award.

curators.name: Alpa Apoorva
curators.title: Relationship insight, emotional clarity and family guidance.
curators.lead: Alpa Apoorva helps individuals and families look beyond biodata to readiness, expectations and long-term fit.
paragraphs: Alpa is an emotional therapist, relationship coach, transformation coach and menopause trainer who works with individuals, couples and families.
Within HeartLink, she helps candidates speak clearly about expectations, values, responsibilities and comfort before marriage.
Her perspective complements Gopi's family and network judgment, giving every serious introduction two equally important lenses.
